items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: Oh, you could hear one time was Alphonse Piku. He played with Manuel Perez.

ctx.x: But I never didn't take to him much. What about Piku? How did he rank? Of course, we heard him when he was pretty old, you know. We never heard him when he was really young. Did he sound much different when he was young?

Yeah, he was rough. He was a terrible clarinet player, huh? When he was young, yeah. Oh, you could hear one time was Alphonse Piku. He played with Manuel Perez. He's dead now. In his dance band or street band? He used to play street band and dance band. No, no. Piku was rough. Well, Piku was the target of town. That's right. I mean, Piku was our best musician, you know, out of all them fans up there. He was a good musician. He was a musician. He was a musician. He was a musician. He was a better musician than all…
I've heard that he was. His father and uncle were too. He was an old Lorenzo and Papazio. I never did hear any of him.
